2: To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' A Psalm of Asaph: a Song. Unto thee we give thanks, OGod, we give thanks; and thy name is near: thy marvellous works declare it.
3: When I shall receive the assembly, I will judge with equity.
4: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have established its pillars. Selah.
5: I said unto the boastful, Boast not; and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
6: Lift not up your horn on high; speak not arrogantly with a [stiff] neck.
7: For not from the east nor from the west, nor yet from the south doth exaltation [come]:
8: ForGod is the judge; he putteth down one and exalteth another.
9: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and it foameth with wine, it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same; yea, the dregs thereof shall all the wicked of the earth drain off, [and] drink.
10: But as for me, I will declare for ever; I will sing psalms to theGod of Jacob.
11: And all the horns of the wicked will I cut off; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
